patches.summary: Treat saved config credentials as satisfying doctor env-var availability.
patches.reason: monday-pp-cli auth set-token stores MONDAY_API_TOKEN in config, so doctor should not keep reporting the env var as missing after auth is configured.
patches.validated_outcome: doctor reports env_vars OK after auth set-token, and whoami/boards list succeed against monday.com.

patches.summary: Enable monday GraphQL resources to hydrate the local SQLite store and make sql query the populated store.
patches.reason: The generated sync surface had an empty default resource list and REST-only fetch path, while this printed CLI's monday surface is hand-written GraphQL. The sql command was also a placeholder that always reported the store as empty.
patches.validated_outcome: sync populated workspaces, boards, users, teams, docs, items, columns, groups, updates, and activity_logs into ~/.local/share/monday-pp-cli/data.db; sql now returns local counts from resources.

patches.summary: Persist, read, and clear monday.com API-key auth from the api_token config slot.
patches.reason: The generated auth skeleton included OAuth/bearer-token slots, but this CLI authenticates with MONDAY_API_TOKEN; logout must remove the persisted api_token as well as legacy auth slots.
patches.validated_outcome: config tests verify auth logout clears api_token and legacy persisted auth fields.

patches.summary: Sort GET params before deriving cache keys.
patches.reason: Go map iteration order is randomized, so identical multi-param GET requests could otherwise hash to different cache files.
patches.validated_outcome: client tests verify cacheKey hashes params in sorted order.

patches.summary: Disable the generated OAuth refresh branch for monday.com API-key auth.
patches.reason: This printed CLI uses non-expiring monday.com API tokens and had no token endpoint; keeping the generated refresh body made the refresh path dead code.
patches.validated_outcome: go test ./... passes with the unreachable refresh branch removed.
